reason: A self-contained DeepSeek Harness utility that adds a sidebar power menu and command or model-tool controls for restarting and shutting down the host process, with supporting lifecycle files and overlays.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏电源菜单，并支持通过界面、命令或可选模型工具重启或关闭主进程。
summaries.en: Adds a sidebar power menu to DeepSeek Harness for restarting or shutting down the host process through the UI, commands, or an optional model tool.

capabilities: Provides sidebar controls for restarting or shutting down the host process
Registers an optional restart_harness model tool
Writes and launches a detached restart helper process
Writes and prunes runtime marker and log files
